subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw make PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession a supported after-compaction plugin API, including the explicit-key compatibility overload?
rationale: This creates a compatibility-sensitive external plugin contract, while the cited compatibility consumer is deployed fork/plugin behavior rather than a proven OpenClaw release contract.

options.title: Approve scoped API only
options.body: Keep the reason-only, current-session, deferred after-compaction method and remove unshipped compatibility and unrelated recovery policy.

options.title: Approve compatibility overload
options.body: Keep both call forms, document their lifecycle and deprecation status, and add upgrade-focused contract tests.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Remove the public hook method and implement reset orchestration only in core-owned overflow recovery.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped API only
recommendation.body: Keep the reason-only, current-session, deferred after-compaction method and remove unshipped compatibility and unrelated recovery policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers both compaction behavior and the gateway session-reset lifecycle.
